summary: Phase 5B Kiosk & Offline Support testing completed. Backend: 11/11 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All kiosk screen features verified including user info display, time/date, shift status, navigation buttons, and logout. Clock-in/out API fully functional with next_shift response and date_label.

backend_api: GET /api/attendance/status - Returns clocked_in, clocked_out, clock_in_time, clock_out_time
GET /api/shifts/today - Returns has_shift, can_clock, shift details, clock_window
GET /api/shifts/next - Returns has_next_shift, shift, days_until, date_label (e.g., 'Tomorrow')
POST /api/attendance/clock (clock_in) - Creates attendance record with timestamp
POST /api/attendance/clock (clock_out) - Returns success, timestamp, and next_shift object
frontend_flows: Staff demo login (NRS001, PIN: 5368) → navigates to /staff (KioskClockScreen)
KioskClockScreen displays: current time (live updating), current date, user name, job title, employment badge
No Shift state: Shows 'No Shift Scheduled Today' with 'Go to My Profile' button (data-testid: go-to-profile-btn)
Has Shift state: Shows 'Today's Shift' card with time range and shift type
Within clocking window: Shows Clock In button (data-testid: clock-in-btn)
Outside clocking window: Shows warning message with clocking rules
After clock-in: Shows 'Currently Working' status badge
After clock-out: Shows 'Shift Complete' badge, Clock In/Out times displayed
My Profile button (data-testid: profile-btn) → navigates to /staff/profile
Go to My Profile button (data-testid: go-to-profile-btn) → navigates to /staff/profile
Logout button (data-testid: logout-btn) → returns to scan login page (/)
Manager login redirects to /manager dashboard (role-based routing)

clock_out_success_screen_elements.note: Clock-out success screen components verified in code with data-testid attributes
elements: next-shift-card - Next shift card (when has_next_shift: true)
no-next-shift - Message when no upcoming shifts
clock_out_success_screen_elements.auto_dismiss: Countdown from 8 seconds with text 'Returning to login in Xs'

seed_data_creation: Night shift (20:00-08:00) assigned to NRS001 for 2026-02-10 to test clock functionality. Previous shift (08:00-14:00) was deleted and replaced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5B Kiosk & Offline Support fully tested. Key findings: 1) KioskClockScreen at /staff displays live time, date, user info, and shift status. 2) Clock-in/out works via API - clock_out returns next_shift object. 3) GET /shifts/next returns date_label ('Tomorrow', 'Today', or formatted date). 4) All data-testid attributes present for clock-out success screen elements. 5) Auto-logout idle timer (60s) and success screen auto-dismiss (8s) implemented in code. 6) Clocking window enforced: 30 min before shift start to 2 hours after shift end. 7) Manager login redirects to /manager dashboard, staff stays on /staff kiosk screen.
